description: Port the requested qr_mega_la_tc structure into the fish n=512 path as a low-footprint one-CTA look-ahead megakernel: replace WMMA with native sm_100a tcgen05/TMEM plus TMA, stream 128-column tiles, retain FP32 panel/T arithmetic and compensated TF32 updates, and cut the old 210 KiB shared-memory footprint.

Build a cluster-tiled n=512 single-launch QR megakernel: four CTAs per matrix, an FP32 NB=16 panel producer publishing compact-WY V/T through DSM, and CTAs updating independent 128-column tiles via cta_group::1 tcgen05/TMA between cluster barriers while preserving hard-case routing and compact Householder output.

Build a resident grid-wide n=512 QR megakernel that fuses FP32 Householder panels with tiled compact-WY updates without sacrificing GPU-wide parallelism: keep V/T in global slabs, schedule 128-column tcgen05/TMA update tasks through a device work queue, and use safe fully-resident phase barriers plus compensated TF32 arithmetic.

Replace the resident grid-wide epoch scheduler with a CTA-local multi-matrix software pipeline: each persistent CTA owns several n=512 matrices, alternates FP32 NB16 panel work for one with 256-column compact-WY updates for another, double-buffers V/T, and removes global phase barriers while preserving hard-case routing and fused single-launch execution.

Make n=512 bulk updates tile-stationary across panel epochs: keep each far-trailing C tile resident in TMEM or shared storage, apply several successive FP32-NB16 compact-WY transforms with compensated tcgen05/TMA before one global writeback, while a lead-panel CTA advances near columns and catches lagging tiles up before they become panel-adjacent.

Combine ff5d40's 32-warp cooperative NB16 panel/transpose core with ab6f034's multi-epoch stationary-TMEM trailing slab and overlapped V/T prefetch, preserving the fast panel reductions while amortizing bulk compact-WY loads/stores in one fused n=512 megakernel.

Combine 03814c's stationary last-128-column tcgen05 slab with 238e710's two-resident-CTA 576-thread 3-panel/15-update ownership. Bracket 576/640/768 threads and 64/96/128 stationary columns to trade per-matrix work for SM residency, retaining a single fused CTA-local n=512 kernel and 296-CTA wave balancing.

Combine 805f3d's four-warp prepack/stationary pipeline with 0ffeee's 640-thread 296-CTA persistent launch. Remove near-update per-thread projected[16] state via lane-striped or shared warpgroup compact-WY transforms, then bracket 640/768/1024 threads. Target a two-resident-CTA register footprint with no local spills while preserving the full last-128 tcgen05 atom and one TMEM allocation per persistent CTA.

Replace 2eab's 31 KiB shared panel_v B prepack with a verified direct tcgen05 transpose-B/MN-major descriptor over the native panel layout. First validate descriptor addressing against the existing packed path, then remove the pack and its 128-thread barrier and reprofile. If direct addressing is impossible, test asynchronous bulk/TMA double-buffered prepack while preserving compact correction staging.

Apply Blackwell warpgroup dynamic register redistribution to dcf112's TMA-staged stationary megakernel. Verify converged setmaxnreg helpers, then bracket stationary-warp donors and 28 near-update-warp receivers around panel/update epochs, restoring before all-warp phases. Measure spills, no-eligible cycles, and barrier cost; if redistribution overhead dominates, isolate role-specific code in noinline helpers to shorten live ranges.

Combine dcf112's fixed-stage TMA stationary first 24 epochs with ccaaa's zero-spill double-buffer lookahead only after the natural slab flush. Leave the TMA era unchanged; for panels 384:512 graft and bracket P16/C16 producer-consumer tails over the last 4/8 phases, reusing buffers where possible and rejecting any whole-kernel register/shared-memory inflation that erases the tail gain.

Specialize 8cfbce's fixed sixteen-stage TMA path by panel group at compile time, avoiding the dynamic active-stage regression. Generate fully unrolled 16/12/8/4-stage issue and constant-K tcgen05 variants with panel-group dispatch outside hot loops; bracket cutoff tables while preserving direct 128-thread acquire waits and swizzled Householder patching, and reject code-size/register growth that erases transfer savings.

Combine 8cfbce's direct 128-thread TMA acquire waits and removed publish barrier with 9e731's eight-phase P16/C16 post-flush lookahead tail. Preserve the fixed sixteen-stage stationary first 24 epochs and shared-buffer reuse; benchmark the minimal additive merge first, then bracket a six-phase tail and isolate tail-driver live ranges only if the combined head remains full-valid and faster.

Combine 2061b3's direct-wait eight-phase lookahead tail with 2d407a's compact absolute 16/12/8 TMA stage groups. Transplant only the grouped issue table while retaining the compact runtime tcgen05 K loop and inline tail; benchmark against 15474.304 us, then re-bracket six/eight-phase boundaries and monitor code size, registers, and aggregate geomean.

Rewrite 2061b3's inline eight-phase post-flush tail as compile-time slot-specialized phase pairs. Use fixed slot0/slot1 shared offsets, panel constants, and barrier parity while keeping the compact factor/update bodies inline; first unroll four phase pairs, then fall back to a two-phase pair loop if code growth hurts. Measure spill traffic, CTA-barrier stalls, and dense latency without a device-call frame.

Restructure 2061b3's inline eight-phase tail synchronization without call isolation. Measure frontier, producer factor/build, consumer far-update, and reuse-join phases; then test all-32-warp dependency-frontier assistance followed by a P16/C16 split, and replace full-CTA reuse joins with slot-specific producer-ready/consumer-done named barriers where dependencies allow. Preserve the stationary era, shared footprint, and compact looped tail bodies.

Extend lookahead into 2061b3's first 24 stationary epochs. Keep warps 0-3 on TMA/tcgen05 stationary work and split the remaining 28 into P8/C20 then P9/C19: producers update the next 16-column dependency frontier and factor/build the next NB16 panel into a double buffer while consumers apply the current panel to remaining near columns. Preserve the proven eight-phase tail and bracket balance with phase counters.

Test the single missing tail boundary on ungrouped 2061b3: set LOOKAHEAD_START=400 for seven P16/C16 phases while retaining fixed sixteen-stage TMA, direct acquire waits, compact runtime K loop, and inline shared-buffer reuse. Run full guards, repeated exclusive dense timing, suite geomean, and profile; if it wins, confirm against both 15474.304-us eight-phase and 15506.755-us six-phase parents before any follow-up.
